82:3: When the seas are made to gush forth
82:5: Every soul knows what it has put forward and what it has left behind.
82:6: O human, what deceived you against your Rabb who is al-Karim?
82:7: He who created you, then fashioned you, then balanced you.
82:8: He is the One who assembled you in whatever form He willed.
82:9: No, never; on the contrary, you deny the Din.
82:10: And surely over you there are guardians.
82:13: Surely the righteous are in bliss.
82:14: And surely the sinners are certainly in Hell.
82:15: They enter it on the Day of Din.
82:16: And they will not disappear from it.
82:17: What is it that informs you what the Day of Din is?
82:18: Then what is it that informs you what the Day of Din is?
82:19: That day, no soul can possess anything for another soul. That day, the command is only Allah's.
